rows: Class 12 pass with Physics, Chemistry, Maths and a qualifying JEE Main attempt, unmarried, roughly 16.5-19.5 years. Open to men and women.

No separate written exam from the Navy. Shortlisting runs on your JEE Main All India Rank, then SSB and medical. Selected cadets get a fully funded 4-year B.Tech at the Indian Naval Academy, Ezhimala, commissioned as Sub-Lieutenant on completion.
Bachelor's degree, engineering degree for the technical entries; age band varies by entry scheme, broadly 19-24.
UPSC written exam plus SSB and medical, for students who did not lock in a Navy seat after 12th and want a route in after a degree instead.

items.heading: A Government
items.text: A government-commissioned defence-forces career, entered through UPSC (NDA) or direct Navy selection (10+2 Cadet Entry Scheme), followed by SSB and medical.

items.heading: Pay Follows the 7th Cpc
items.text: Pay follows the 7th CPC defence pay matrix plus Military Service Pay, with a pension track for officers who complete the qualifying period.

items.heading: Work Includes Naval Warfare Readiness,
items.text: Work includes naval warfare readiness, ship and submarine operations, defence of Indian waters, and disaster-response duties, alongside sea postings and shore postings.
